description: Independently authored C cases mirroring the SHAPES of upstream bounds/malloc/div-zero/spatial-temporal tests. No upstream source text is copied. Every case asserts exact C+ diagnostics in DEFAULT and STRICT with --sanitize=none, and exact runtime output/exit status where a build succeeds.
compiler_version_note: Assertions were captured against build/c+ (C+ 0.1.0) on 2026-11-23; paths are normalised to <SRC> before matching.
